expectations.text: Produces a usable literature matrix (not a refusal) with per-source rows

Constr.* 112:103088 | 2020 | Q1 journal | Damage là BIM object có type/code ... | condition evidence | 2 | ... | Không có per-finding source provenance ...'. No refusal; the artifact is directly usable for drafting Related Work.

expectations.text: Organises or groups the matrix by chain element rather than only by year
expectations.evidence: §1 header: 'Literature matrix — sắp theo chain element' and 'Sắp theo **chain element**, không theo năm.' Sections run 1.1 condition evidence, 1.2 component identity, 1.3 Inspection_Record, 1.4 Action_Record, 1.5 status/event history, 1.6 authorization, 1.7 verification/closure, 1.8 validation method. Each row also carries an explicit 'Chain element' column.

expectations.text: Includes an explicit 'limitation for this thesis' style column or equivalent per-source limitation
expectations.evidence: Every sub-matrix carries the column 'Giới hạn đối với luận án' (limitation with respect to the thesis), populated per source, e.g. Kim et al. 2018: 'Dùng **IFC instance number** (`#31982`, `#66803`), **không** dùng `GlobalId` ... G2 phải cố định đường đó tường minh.'

expectations.text: Cites sources with a repository path or locator rather than from unsourced memory
expectations.evidence: Locator convention stated up front ('Ký hiệu locator: `[Tác giả Năm, PDF p. n, §x]`') and applied per cell, e.g. '`[PDF pp. 6–9, 19, §§3.2.2.1–3.2.2.3, Figs. 7–9, 24–25]` (R2)'. §10 Evidence and §11 list repository files read: `02_EVIDENCE_BASE/RQ2_GATES2_3/G2_G3_ROUND1_DEEP_READ_AND_NOVELTY_BOUNDARY.md`, `ROUND4_VERIFIED_EVIDENCE_RECORD_v1.1.md`, etc.
